title: Baby Leo & Friends Learn About Brushing Teeth!
summary: Today, Baby Leo and friends learn about brushing their teeth! Marjona has a fun song to teach everyone how to keep their smiles bright and healthy. Together, they discover that brushing teeth can be an exciting part of their daily routine!
lesson: Kids learn the importance of brushing their teeth and how to do it properly.
beats: Baby Leo and Friends gather at their play area, discussing what they learned about healthy eating. Marjona smiles and says that a healthy smile is also important.
Marjona shares her toothbrush and some toothpaste with the friends, explaining how brushing teeth helps keep them clean and strong.
The friends sing a silly tooth-brushing song together, adding fun movements while pretending to brush their teeth.
Suddenly, Bobo remembers that he forgot to brush his own teeth! He feels a bit shy but asks for help.
Bella comes up with a clever plan. She suggests that they all brush their teeth together to make it fun!
They find a mirror and gather around, showing each other how to brush in small circles and reach all the tricky spots.
Twinkle adds her sparkle magic, making the toothbrushes shine bright as they brush their teeth with joy.
After brushing, they all show off their bright smiles in the mirror, feeling proud of their clean teeth.
Bobo gives everyone a warm hug and thanks them for helping him remember to brush his teeth.
Together, they celebrate their happy smiles and decide to make brushing their teeth a fun daily routine!
